column1: # gate-tools.tsv - the tools a tools/testrunner command unit may ask for
# (scripts/ci/gate-commands.tsv, tools column) and the tools the host checks
# install (scripts/ci/gate-host-checks.sh), pinned by version and digest per
# architecture. tools/testrunner/bootstrap.sh installs a tool once per
# machine from this row and refuses a download whose digest differs.
# Columns (tab separated): tool  version  arch  digest  url
#   digest  the project's published sha256 (64 hex); where a project
#           publishes only SHA-512 (Apache Maven), its sha512 (128 hex).
#           Never a digest computed here: every one comes from the
#           project's own checksum file (or, where it has none, from the
#           digest GitHub records for the release asset), named per tool
#           below.
#   url     a .tar.gz/.tgz or .tar.xz archive (unpacked; a single top
#           directory is stripped, so bin/ or the binary lands at the
#           tool's root) or a bare binary (installed as <tool>); bootstrap
#           puts the tool's root and its bin/ on PATH.
# golangci-lint: the version ci.yml's lint job pins (golangci-lint-action
#   `version: v2.14.0`); sha256 from the release's
#   golangci-lint-2.14.0-checksums.txt.
# node: ci.yml pins only the major (`node-version: '22'`, setup-node takes
#   the newest 22.x); the runner pins the newest 22.x at the time of writing,
#   v22.23.5, with the sha256 from nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.5/SHASUMS256.txt.
#   Move it with CI's major.
# node20, node22, node24: the SDK matrix (lane B4, plan W2-4 / principle 9:
#   sdk/typescript on every Node major its engines field admits that is
#   still tested; scripts/ci/sdk.sh). Official nodejs.org tarballs, the
#   newest release of each major at the time of writing, sha256 from that
#   release's SHASUMS256.txt. node22 pins the same tarball as node but is a
#   row of its own, so moving the web suites to a newer major does not move
#   the SDK's Node 22 unit.
# python3.9 .. python3.13: the SDK matrix for sdk/python (requires-python
#   >=3.9). CPython install_only_stripped builds from python-build-standalone
#   (the builds uv installs): the tarball unpacks to python/, so bootstrap's
#   top-directory strip leaves bin/python3 on PATH. The newest patch of each
#   minor at the time of writing; sha256 from uv 0.13.9's
#   download-metadata.json, which uv verifies these same URLs against. 3.9
#   is end of life upstream (its last build is 20251031); keep it while
#   requires-python says >=3.9.
# shellcheck: the installer:linux unit (ci.yml's installer job, Linux leg,
#   runs the runner image's shellcheck, 0.9.0-1 from apt on ubuntu-24.04).
#   Pinned to 0.11.0, the newest release: 0.9.0 publishes no checksum and
#   GitHub recorded no digest for its assets, while 0.11.0's .tar.gz assets
#   carry GitHub's sha256 digest (the release API's assets[].digest), which
#   is the digest here. scripts/install.sh and scripts/test-install.sh are
#   clean under 0.11.0 (checked 2026-11-21). The tarball unpacks to
#   shellcheck-v0.11.0/shellcheck (no bin/).
# jdk17: the sdk:java-17 unit (ci.yml's sdk job, java-17 leg: setup-java
#   `distribution: temurin`, `java-version: 17`, which takes the newest 17).
#   Eclipse Temurin 17.0.21.1+2, the newest 17 at the time of writing (the
#   Adoptium API's assets/latest/17/hotspot); sha256 from the release's
#   <file>.sha256.txt. Unpacks to jdk-17.0.21.1+2/ (bin/java, bin/javac).
# maven: the sdk:java-17 unit's mvn (ci.yml's java leg uses the runner
#   image's Maven, 3.10.1 on ubuntu-24.04). Apache Maven 3.10.1 from Maven
#   Central (the same bytes as downloads.apache.org). Apache publishes only
#   SHA-512, so the digest is the release's apache-maven-3.10.1-bin.tar.gz
#   .sha512 (identical on Maven Central and downloads.apache.org). One
#   archive for both architectures (Java). Unpacks to apache-maven-3.10.1/.
# helm, kind, kubectl, tofu: the host checks (scripts/ci/gate-host-checks.sh),
#   never a gate unit. helm: ci-private.yml's helm job (azure/setup-helm
#   `version: v3.21.0`); sha256 from get.helm.sh's <file>.sha256sum.
#   kind, kubectl: what helm/kind-action@v1.14.0 installs by default (its
#   kind.sh: DEFAULT_KIND_VERSION=v0.31.0, DEFAULT_KUBECTL_VERSION=v1.35.0);
#   bare binaries, sha256 from kind's kind-linux-<arch>.sha256sum release
#   asset and dl.k8s.io's kubectl.sha256 (the files kind-action checks).
#   tofu: ci-private.yml's tofu job (opentofu/setup-opentofu
#   `tofu_version: 1.12.6`); sha256 from the release's
#   tofu_1.12.6_SHA256SUMS. Its tarball has no top directory.
